Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits, you can easily take the follow-up damage too, so move with minions between you. When Charm comes toward you, dodge it with Fizz E Playful / Trickster. After dodging the first cast of Ahri Q Orb of Deception, keep moving outside the path of its return.
Ahri.build: Ahri P Essence Theft healing can offset your burst, so get Oblivion Orb first and upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to build a core item. Build magic resistance against Ahri’s magic damage, but withstand the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception—which magic resistance cannot reduce—with your health pool. Avoiding Ahri E Charm and her follow-up combo takes priority over items.
Ahri.fight: Fizz has no innate healing, so whittle Ahri down with short trades before going for the finish. The moment Ahri E Charm is used is your chance to engage. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is also down, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge her counterattack.
Ahri.laning: Keep a line of minions between you to block Ahri E Charm, and use Fizz P Nimble Fighter’s unit pass-through to approach between minions. Secure last hits with Fizz W Seastone Trident to preserve mana and ability uptime. If you push Ahri out of lane, push the wave toward her tower, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Ahri.combo: Hit Ahri with Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up. Use Fizz W Seastone Trident’s empowered attack while she is airborne, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to disengage.
Ahri.escape: Engage after Ahri E Charm is used to avoid getting hit by it during Fizz Q Urchin Strike’s dash. If Charm is still available, think carefully before using Fizz E Playful / Trickster to engage first.
Ahri.phase: Fizz’s burst rises in the mid game once Fizz R Chum the Waters and his first core item are ready. Fizz remains strong at assassinating a single target in the late game, but it is hard to engage if Ahri’s team is grouped up.
Ahri.teamfight: Wait on a flank for Ahri E Charm to be used, then use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target someone in the backline. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster before engaging so you can respond to a counterattack. If it is hard to catch a target, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

Akali.watch: Inside Akali W Twilight Shroud, you can throw Fizz R Chum the Waters during the brief window when she becomes visible.
Akali.build: Add magic penetration to your offensive items first to deal with Akali’s high magic resistance. If you need defense, build magic resistance over armor, and get health to prepare for Akali R Perfect Execution’s damage based on missing health.
Akali.fight: Engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, land Fizz W Seastone Trident’s empowered attack, and use Fizz E Playful / Trickster against her counterattack. You take attacks during Fizz Q Urchin Strike’s dash, so don’t force an engage while Akali still has attacks available.
Akali.combo: Hit Akali with Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up. Use Fizz W Seastone Trident’s empowered attack while she is airborne, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster for a counterattack or disengage.
Akali.escape: Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution can all be used to escape, so don’t engage as soon as just one is used.
Akali.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating a single target in the late game, but it is hard to engage if the enemy team is grouped up.
Akali.teamfight: From a flank, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target someone in the backline, and engage while saving Fizz E Playful / Trickster. If your target is hiding behind the enemy formation, focus on scattering it with Fizz R Chum the Waters.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so don’t try to dodge by standing behind the minion wave. Watch its path both on the way out and back, and be ready to use Fizz E Playful / Trickster against attacks you need to dodge. If Akshan R Comeuppance is targeting you while your health is low, hide behind terrain instead of running alone into the open.
Akshan.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Akshan’s main damage is physical and Fizz has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Akshan.laning: After that, farm outside the range of Akshan Q Avengerang’s poke, and secure last hits with Fizz W Seastone Trident to preserve mana and ability uptime. Fizz has no innate healing, so whittle him down with short trades before going for the finish.
Akshan.combo: Once Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, hit him with Fizz R Chum the Waters, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks him up. Use Fizz W Seastone Trident’s empowered attack while he is airborne, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to disengage.
Akshan.escape: Engage right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is used. The provided information does not include Akshan’s crowd control abilities, so also check whether you can save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge a counterattack before going in.
Akshan.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating a single target in the late game, but choose your engage carefully if Akshan is grouped with his allies.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can be detonated again to stun, so don’t stop at sidestepping it slightly: dodge the explosion with Fizz E Playful or dive toward Anivia. If you are hit by Q or are inside a fully grown Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals increased damage, so leave the storm immediately. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.
Anivia.fight: If Anivia Q Flash Frost and W Crystallize are available, engaging first with Fizz Q Urchin Strike makes it easy to get counterattacked, so go in after both are used. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, fight alongside an ally who can also destroy the egg.
Anivia.laning: Fizz has no innate healing, so build up short trades before going for the finish. Fizz P Nimble Fighter lets you pass between minions to approach, and last-hitting with Fizz W Seastone Trident preserves mana and ability uptime. If you push Anivia out of lane, push the wave toward her tower, then join the jungle or a side lane.
Anivia.combo: The safest sequence is to hit Anivia with Fizz R Chum the Waters, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up, then land Fizz W Seastone Trident’s empowered attack. Save Fizz E Playful to dodge Anivia Q Flash Frost or W Crystallize and disengage. If both crowd control abilities are already down, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, land the W empowered attack, and use E against her counterattack.
Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility ability, so the moment Anivia Q Flash Frost and W Crystallize are used is Fizz’s chance to engage. Then close the gap with Fizz Q Urchin Strike or E Playful and hit with Fizz R Chum the Waters. If her crowd control is still available, use Fizz E Playful to approach first so you don’t lose your escape option.
Anivia.phase: Fizz remains strong at solo assassinations in the late game, but it is hard to engage if Anivia controls narrow terrain or the enemy team is grouped up, so look for opportunities in open areas.
Anivia.teamfight: From a flank instead of head-on, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target someone in the backline. Engage when Anivia Q Flash Frost and W Crystallize are down and Fizz E Playful is available. Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape in narrow jungle paths, so fight in open areas. If you can’t reach the target you need to pick off, use R to scatter the formation.

Ambessa.watch: When you see Ambessa W Repudiation’s shield and windup, don’t attack; walk out of range. If you dodge the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, the second hit won’t come. If it’s hard to dodge, move close to her to avoid the blade’s edge. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, don’t wait for the slow to wear off; dodge the follow-up attack with Fizz E Playful / Trickster. Ambessa R Public Execution can’t be interrupted by crowd control, so evade it with Fizz E Playful / Trickster’s untargetability.
Ambessa.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If Ambessa R Public Execution’s healing makes her hard to kill, get Oblivion Orb first, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to delay a core item.
Ambessa.combo: The safest sequence is to land Fizz R Chum the Waters, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up. While she’s airborne, use Fizz W Seastone Trident’s empowered basic attack, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to escape. If you see Ambessa W Repudiation winding up, stop attacking and leave its range.
Ambessa.escape: Engage right after Ambessa uses R Public Execution and her other key abilities, and spends the charge from Ambessa P Drakehound’s Step. If Ambessa R Public Execution is still available, she can hit you while you’re dashing with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, so don’t force an engage. When dodging Ambessa’s crowd control or delayed attacks, don’t recast Fizz E Playful / Trickster; use the full duration of its untargetability.
Ambessa.phase: Ambessa gets stronger in the mid game as she builds core items, so avoid giving up kills early and keep up in levels. Fizz remains strong at assassinating isolated targets late, but it’s difficult to engage when the enemy team is grouped.

Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, don’t enter the range of Annie’s abilities. You can evade the area damage from Annie R Summon: Tibbers with Fizz E Playful / Trickster’s untargetability, but you’ll take damage over time if you stay near the summoned Tibbers.
Annie.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor for your first defensive purchase. Annie deals magic damage, and Annie R Summon: Tibbers has penetration, so even after building resistance, avoid getting locked down by her stun and hit by her full combo.
Annie.fight: Go in briefly to chip away at Annie’s health right after she uses Annie P Pyromania’s stun. Fizz has no innate healing, so build up poke and look for a finishing opportunity instead of trying to end the fight all at once early on.
Annie.laning: Last-hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident to get mana back and use your abilities again sooner. If you push Annie out of lane, push the wave toward her turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Annie.combo: After Annie’s stun is used, land Fizz R Chum the Waters first. Close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up, use Fizz W Seastone Trident’s empowered basic attack, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster for the counterattack.
Annie.escape: Annie has no mobility, so the window to engage is after she uses Annie P Pyromania’s stun. You’ll take attacks while dashing in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, so save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to respond if dangerous abilities are still available.
Annie.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating isolated targets late, but it’s difficult to engage when the enemy team is grouped, so look for a flank.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is missing or Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, don’t stand close to your allies. After her stun is used, target someone in the back line from a flank with Fizz R Chum the Waters, while saving Fizz E Playful / Trickster. If you can’t engage, scatter the formation with Fizz R Chum the Waters.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health and stacks Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its aim. When your health is low, also avoid the edge of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, where you can be executed; if caught, immediately walk out. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.build: Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light scales with your maximum health, consider not only health but also having enough to stay out of Aurelion Sol E Singularity’s execute zone and enough movement speed to escape its area.
AurelionSol.fight: Chip away at his health and look for a finishing opportunity while his Stardust is low early on, especially after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is on cooldown. Before engaging with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, check that Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend are on cooldown. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge his counterattack and get out.
AurelionSol.laning: Take Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light behind minions, but quickly leave its aim so you don’t give him Stardust. Secure last hits with Fizz W Seastone Trident to restore mana and improve your ability rotation, and build up short trades since you have no innate healing. If you push him out, push the wave toward his turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
AurelionSol.combo: When Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is on cooldown, land Fizz R Chum the Waters first. Close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks him up, then use Fizz W Seastone Trident’s empowered basic attack. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend and escape.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment Aurelion Sol uses Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is your chance to close the distance. If Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend are also on cooldown, engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to escape.
AurelionSol.phase: Fizz can apply pressure early, when Aurelion Sol has little Stardust and you can look for an opening after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is on cooldown. In the mid game, make use of the burst you have once Fizz R Chum the Waters and your first core item are ready. Late game, you’re at a disadvantage as Stardust from Aurelion Sol P Cosmic Creator accumulates permanently, so don’t engage head-on against a grouped enemy team.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Target someone in the back line with Fizz R Chum the Waters from a flank. Engage when Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend are on cooldown and Fizz E Playful / Trickster is available. Spread out so several allies don’t get hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend late. If you can’t pick someone off, scatter the formation with Fizz R Chum the Waters.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when it returns, and the return damage increases as Fizz’s health gets lower. If you’re cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora, and use Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge the return timing. You’ll be slowed if you leave Aurora R Between Worlds after it’s cast, so decide whether to retreat before the zone appears or fight inside it.
Aurora.build: If Aurora P Spirit Abjuration’s healing offsets your assassination damage, get Oblivion Orb first. Upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to delay a core item. Aurora deals magic damage, so choose magic resistance over armor when you need resistance.
Aurora.fight: Fizz has no innate healing, so chip away at Aurora’s health with short trades before looking for a kill. Bait out Aurora E The Weirding, check how much mobility she has left, then go back in. You’ll take attacks while dashing with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, so use it to engage after Aurora Q Twofold Hex is on cooldown.
Aurora.laning: Early on, use Fizz E Playful / Trickster sparingly because of its mana cost and cooldown. You can approach through minions with Fizz P Nimble Fighter and use Fizz W Seastone Trident for a short trade. If you push Aurora out of lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Aurora.combo: When Aurora’s escape is on cooldown, land Fizz R Chum the Waters first. Close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up, then use Fizz W Seastone Trident’s empowered basic attack. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge Aurora’s counterattack or escape.
Aurora.escape: Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, and Aurora R Between Worlds are all mobility abilities, so don’t go in just because one is on cooldown. Your opening is especially good before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back, once Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are also on cooldown. After confirming Aurora Q Twofold Hex is on cooldown, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster.
Aurora.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating isolated targets late, but it’s difficult to engage when the enemy team is grouped.
Aurora.teamfight: Target someone in the back line with Fizz R Chum the Waters from a flank instead of going in head-on. Engage when Aurora Q Twofold Hex is on cooldown and Fizz E Playful / Trickster is available. If Aurora jumps in and fails to kill anyone, that’s an opportunity to catch her. If it’s hard to reach a target you can pick off, scatter the formation with Fizz R Chum the Waters.

Azir.watch: Before Azir Q Conquering Sands repositions his soldiers, avoid the straight line they occupy. After he casts it, close in while the soldiers are stopped. Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock Fizz back if he dives in, so don't force an engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike while Azir R is available. Save Fizz E Playful.
Azir.build: Azir deals magic damage, so build magic resistance before armor. Consider movement speed so you can get out of the soldiers' attack range.
Azir.fight: Look for a short trade after Azir Q Conquering Sands, while his soldiers are stopped, or after Azir E Shifting Sands is down. Fizz has no innate healing, so whittle Azir down with short trades before going for the kill instead of trying to finish him in one go early.
Azir.laning: Last-hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident. When roaming, push the wave toward Azir's turret.
Azir.combo: After Azir E Shifting Sands is down, land Fizz R Chum the Waters first. When the shark knocks Azir up, follow with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and hit him with Fizz W Seastone Trident's empowered attack. Save Fizz E Playful to disengage.
Azir.escape: Right after you make Azir use Azir E Shifting Sands, look to close the gap with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and Fizz E Playful. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is still available, it can knock you back during Fizz Q Urchin Strike, so engage after Azir R is down.
Azir.phase: In the mid game, once you have Fizz R Chum the Waters and your first core item, look for brief assassination opportunities. Azir gets stronger as the game goes on, so don't force your way into grouped enemies in the late game.
Azir.teamfight: In narrow corridors, Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock back multiple enemies, so look for a flank in open areas. When Azir R Emperor's Divide is down and Fizz E Playful is available, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to pick off a backline target. If you can't engage, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

Cassiopeia.watch: While poisoned, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals more.
Cassiopeia.laning: Last-hitting with Fizz W Seastone Trident refunds mana and lets you cast the ability again sooner.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility spell to create distance on her own, so look to engage right after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere.

Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets around the first one it hits, so don't hide behind minions; get out of its range. Move away especially to avoid being hit by the third missile in quick succession. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces both your armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of standing your ground in front of him.
Corki.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first to deal with Corki's main damage. However, Corki P Hextech Munitions deals true damage that resistances can't reduce, and Corki E Gatling Gun also shreds your armor where it hits, so adjust your position first.
Corki.fight: Close the gap right after Corki W Valkyrie is down. Engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, get a short trade with Fizz W Seastone Trident's empowered attack, and use Fizz E Playful / Trickster to avoid his counterattack. You'll take hits during Fizz Q Urchin Strike's dash, so watch for an opportunity to dodge Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb and Corki R Missile Barrage before engaging.
Corki.laning: During the first five levels, pressure Corki's farming and create opportunities for ganks. Fizz has no innate healing, so whittle Corki down with short trades before going for the kill. If you push Corki out of lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret and join a side lane or the jungle.
Corki.combo: After Corki W Valkyrie is down, land Fizz R Chum the Waters first. When the shark knocks Corki up, follow with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, then hit him with Fizz W Seastone Trident's empowered attack while he's airborne. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to disengage or avoid a counterattack.
Corki.escape: Right after Corki W Valkyrie is the window to engage. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb or Corki R Missile Barrage when needed.
Corki.phase: Corki gets stronger as he builds items and can fire missiles from a safe position in the mid to late game, so in the late game Fizz should look for isolated targets instead of grouped enemies.
Corki.teamfight: From a flank, watch for Corki W Valkyrie to go down, then use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target Corki in the backline. Don't waste Fizz E Playful / Trickster beforehand so you can use it when you engage. If Corki is behind his team's formation and difficult to pick off, don't force an engage; use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the formation.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge to the side instead of only backing away. If you're hit by its mark, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so create distance. Don't engage right after Diana W Pale Cascade; wait for its spheres and shield to disappear. Use Fizz E Playful / Trickster's untargetability to avoid Diana R Moonfall.
Diana.build: For your first purchase, prioritize movement speed to help you get out of the range of Diana's telegraphed attacks. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance to counter Diana's magic damage.
Diana.fight: Repeat short trades after the spheres and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. Before engaging with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, check that Diana R Moonfall is down, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to avoid her counterattack. If you're hit by the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, back away instead of trying to catch her.
Diana.combo: The safest sequence is to land Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then follow with Fizz Q Urchin Strike when the shark knocks Diana up. Hit her with Fizz W Seastone Trident's empowered attack while she's airborne, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to disengage.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark, look for a chance to catch her with the slow from Fizz E Playful / Trickster or Fizz R Chum the Waters right after that mobility spell is down. When engaging with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, wait until Diana R Moonfall is also down. If you're hit by the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, Diana E Lunar Rush resets, so don't engage; create distance.
Diana.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating isolated targets in the late game, but engaging is difficult when enemies are grouped.
Diana.teamfight: Diana R Moonfall deals more damage based on the number of champions it pulls, so spread out from your allies and watch for a flank. When Diana R Moonfall is down and Fizz E Playful / Trickster is available, use Fizz R Chum the Waters from a flank to target one enemy in the backline. If it's difficult to pick off the target, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

Ekko.watch: Ekko Q Timewinder’s returning hit deals more damage, so step out of its return path. If you see Ekko’s afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even if he is low on health.
Ekko.build: If the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak offsets your burst, get an Oblivion Orb first to counter Fizz’s magic damage, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon once you can afford to invest in a core item. Choose magic resistance over armor to defend against Ekko’s damage. If you have no mobility spell to dodge the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence, prioritize tenacity over resistances.
Ekko.fight: After dodging Ekko W Parallel Convergence, chip away at his health with short trades before committing to a finishing fight. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is on cooldown, he can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so look for an opening after his ultimate is also down. When you engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, you are not untargetable, so make sure you have dodged the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence first.
Ekko.laning: Early on, Fizz E Playful / Trickster has a high mana cost and a long cooldown, so save it to dodge Ekko W Parallel Convergence. Last-hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident to refund mana and use the ability again sooner. If you push Ekko out of lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Ekko.combo: Dodge Ekko W Parallel Convergence and wait until Ekko R Chronobreak is down, then hit Ekko with Fizz R Chum the Waters first. As the shark knocks Ekko up, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land an empowered basic attack with Fizz W Seastone Trident. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge a counterattack or disengage.
Ekko.escape: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, move out of its range. If you need to dodge it with Fizz E Playful / Trickster, don’t recast E too early. Once both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down, close the distance with Fizz Q Urchin Strike or Fizz E Playful / Trickster. If Ekko E Phase Dive has just gone on cooldown too, you have an opportunity to catch him with Fizz R Chum the Waters.
Ekko.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating an isolated target late game, but it is difficult to engage when the enemy team is grouped.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the distance, so keep your distance when minions are about to die. Dodge the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet with Fizz E Playful, but don’t recast E if you need to remain untargetable. If you are trapped by Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Fizz has low armor, so build armor first. If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge interferes with your assassination, get an Oblivion Orb first and upgrade it to Morellonomicon once you can afford to delay a core item.
Irelia.fight: The moment after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge is an opportunity to close the distance. After Irelia E Flawless Duet is down, engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land an empowered basic attack with W Seastone Trident; use E Playful to respond to her counterattack. Fizz has no self-healing, so chip away at her health with short trades before going for the finish.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between Irelia and Fizz, and watch for Irelia to chain in with Q Bladesurge. If you push Irelia out of lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Irelia.combo: The safest sequence is to hit Irelia with Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up. While she is airborne, land an empowered basic attack with W Seastone Trident and save E Playful to disengage. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is still available, delay your Q engage.
Irelia.escape: Engage during the window when Irelia Q Bladesurge and E Flawless Duet are down. If Irelia E Flawless Duet comes at you, dodge it with the untargetable state from Fizz E Playful. When you need to create distance, you can use Fizz Q Urchin Strike on an enemy minion to get away.
Irelia.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating an isolated target late game, but it is difficult to engage when the enemy team is grouped.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia in teamfights because she can split the formation with R Vanguard's Edge and stun with E Flawless Duet. From the flank, catch a target with Fizz R Chum the Waters, but engage only after Irelia E Flawless Duet is down and when Fizz E Playful is available. If it is difficult to catch a target, don’t force the engage; use R to scatter the enemy formation.

Galio.watch: When Galio charges W Shield of Durand, he takes reduced damage and the taunt lasts longer, so don’t use your burst; move out of range. You can dodge Galio E Justice Punch with Fizz E Playful / Trickster by watching for its windup as he steps back. Avoid the overlapping whirlwind zones from Galio Q Winds of War, and immediately walk out of range when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Galio.build: Fizz’s burst increases once he completes his first core item, so look for an opportunity around that timing. Galio gains both damage and defense as his magic resistance increases, so consider magic penetration before adding more ability power. Choose magic resistance over armor to defend against Galio’s main damage.
Galio.fight: While Galio charges W Shield of Durand, don’t unload your damage; move outside the taunt’s range. After Galio W Shield of Durand and Galio E Justice Punch are down, deal a short burst of damage, chip away at his health, then go for the finish. During the dash from Fizz Q Urchin Strike, you take attacks normally, so don’t engage while crowd control is still available.
Galio.laning: Last-hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident to maintain your mana and ability uptime. When Galio has spent mana using his abilities to clear the wave, push the lane to limit his opportunity to affect other lanes with Galio R Hero's Entrance. When Fizz roams, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Galio.combo: The safest sequence is to hit Galio with Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks him up. While he is airborne, land an empowered basic attack with Fizz W Seastone Trident, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge Galio’s counterattack or disengage.
Galio.escape: Don’t engage just because Galio E Justice Punch is down; also check whether Galio W Shield of Durand and Galio R Hero's Entrance are available. In particular, before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back up, close the distance with Fizz Q Urchin Strike or Fizz E Playful / Trickster during a window when crowd control is down, then pressure his escape route with Fizz R Chum the Waters.
Galio.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating an isolated target late game, but it is difficult to engage when Galio’s team is grouped, so target enemies who are separated.
Galio.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; target a backline enemy from the flank with Fizz R Chum the Waters. Engage when the crowd control from Galio W Shield of Durand, Galio E Justice Punch, and Galio R Hero's Entrance is down and Fizz E Playful / Trickster is available. If the target is safely positioned behind the enemy formation, give up on the engage and scatter the formation with Fizz R Chum the Waters.

Hwei.watch: If you are caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment’s root or pull, you are likely to be hit by a string of follow-up attacks. If Hwei’s first ability hits you, move immediately or dodge the next ability with Fizz E Playful / Trickster. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster before engaging so you can dodge the area where Hwei Q Subject: Disaster lands and Hwei R Spiraling Despair.
Hwei.build: The available information does not specify a particular first purchase. Prioritize magic resistance among defensive stats, and movement speed is also useful for leaving the range of telegraphed attacks.
Hwei.fight: The moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to poke or clear the wave is an opportunity to close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike. Chip away at Hwei’s health with a short trade using Fizz W Seastone Trident, then go for the finish. Choose carefully before using Fizz E Playful / Trickster to engage, as it leaves you with less ability to disengage.
Hwei.laning: Early on, use Fizz E Playful / Trickster conservatively because it has a high mana cost and a long cooldown. Use Fizz W Seastone Trident to last-hit minions; it refunds mana and makes the ability easier to use again. If you push Hwei out of lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Hwei.combo: The safest sequence is to hit Hwei with Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks him up. While he is airborne, land an empowered basic attack with Fizz W Seastone Trident and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge a counterattack or disengage. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is already down, you can also close in first with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land Fizz W Seastone Trident for a short trade.
Hwei.escape: Engage immediately after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. Hwei has no mobility spell, so once you close the distance, you have an opportunity to catch him with Fizz R Chum the Waters. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, wait; you can be hit by its crowd control during the dash from Fizz Q Urchin Strike.
Hwei.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating an isolated target late game, but it is difficult to engage when Hwei is grouped with his allies.
Hwei.teamfight: From the flank instead of the front, wait for Hwei E Subject: Torment to go down, then target a backline enemy with Fizz R Chum the Waters. Don’t use Fizz E Playful / Trickster to poke before engaging; save it to handle a counterattack and disengage. If your target is hiding behind your team’s formation, don’t dive recklessly; scatter the formation with Fizz R Chum the Waters.

Karma.watch: Dodge free Karma Q Inner Flame poke by moving behind minions or out of range; each hit grants Karma P Gathering Fire, bringing Karma R Mantra back sooner. Walk out immediately from the circle left by Karma R Mantra-empowered Q Inner Flame.
Karma.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Karma Q Inner Flame and W Focused Resolve. Movement speed is also useful for dodging the marked area and escaping Karma W Focused Resolve’s tether. If healing from Karma R Mantra-empowered W Focused Resolve prevents an assassination, buy Oblivion Orb for Fizz’s magic damage first, then upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford it.
Karma.fight: Trade briefly after Karma W Focused Resolve and R Mantra are down, then re-engage when you can finish her. If you engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge her counterattack. Don’t unload burst right after Karma’s R Mantra-empowered E Inspire shield comes up.
Karma.laning: Fizz P Nimble Fighter lets you approach through minions, but don’t keep taking Karma Q Inner Flame poke. Use Fizz W Seastone Trident to secure last hits and preserve mana and ability uptime; save Fizz E Playful / Trickster early, when it is costly to use. If you push Karma out of lane, push the wave toward her turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Karma.combo: Land Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks Karma up. While she is airborne, land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to escape. If Karma’s R Mantra-empowered E Inspire shield is active, start this combo after it expires.
Karma.escape: Engage when Karma W Focused Resolve and R Mantra are down and the movement speed from Karma E Inspire has worn off. You take attacks during Fizz Q Urchin Strike’s dash, so don’t rush in with Q while Karma still has her key abilities. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, use Fizz E Playful / Trickster to create distance before the root lands.
Karma.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating a lone target in the late game, but it’s hard to engage if Karma is grouped with her team.
Karma.teamfight: Wait on a flank, then engage after Karma W Focused Resolve and R Mantra are down and the shield from empowered Karma E Inspire has expired. Use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target someone in the backline, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster for counterattacks and escape. If your target is hiding behind the enemy formation, don’t dive deep; use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter them.

Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs Fizz’s magic damage, so poke while Q is down. Watch for the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse and Kassadin R Riftwalk, and account for his ability to escape while R is available.
Kassadin.build: Kassadin Q Null Sphere, W Nether Blade, and E Force Pulse all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana, so healing reduction is not a priority.
Kassadin.fight: When Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield is down, chip away at his health with an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster for his counterattack.
Kassadin.laning: Using unnecessary abilities near Kassadin reduces Kassadin E Force Pulse’s cooldown, so clear the wave from outside his range whenever possible. Before joining another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret.
Kassadin.combo: When Kassadin R Riftwalk and Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield are both down, land Fizz R Chum the Waters first. Close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks him up, land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to escape.
Kassadin.escape: Engage while Kassadin R Riftwalk is down. If Kassadin E Force Pulse is down too, you can close the gap with Fizz Q Urchin Strike without worrying about its slow disrupting you. If Kassadin has used R repeatedly, check his mana bar to see whether he can move again before counterattacking.
Kassadin.phase: In the late game, Kassadin can use R to enter and leave the backline, so don’t stand alone within range of Kassadin R.
Kassadin.teamfight: From a flank, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target one backline enemy, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster before engaging. If Kassadin R Riftwalk is available, he can escape your engage, so check whether he uses it. If you can’t reach the target you need to catch, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

Lissandra.watch: Being caught by Lissandra W Ring of Frost’s root or Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s stun makes you vulnerable to a counterattack. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster while either ability is available, and avoid standing in line with allied minions to dodge Lissandra Q Ice Shard.
Lissandra.build: Healing from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb can negate your assassination damage, so buy Oblivion Orb first and complete Morellonomicon when you can afford the core item. Against Lissandra’s damage, build magic resistance rather than armor.
Lissandra.fight: Trade briefly right after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. Fizz has no built-in healing, so chip away at her health before going for a finish instead of trying to kill her in one go.
Lissandra.laning: Farm from an angle that avoids the piercing path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard by standing out of line with allied minions. Use Fizz W Seastone Trident to secure last hits and preserve mana and ability uptime. If you push her out of lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret, then join your team.
Lissandra.combo: When Lissandra E Glacial Path is down and the threat of a counterattack from Lissandra W Ring of Frost and R Frozen Tomb is reduced, land Fizz R Chum the Waters first. Close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up, land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to escape. If Lissandra can make herself untargetable with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, space out your damage so you can keep dealing it after she becomes targetable again.
Lissandra.escape: Right after Lissandra uses E Glacial Path is your chance to close the gap. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost and R Frozen Tomb are still available, don’t rush in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike; engage after those crowd-control abilities are down. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge her counterattack or escape.
Lissandra.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating a lone target in the late game, but it’s hard to engage if the enemy team is grouped.
Lissandra.teamfight: Engage from a flank after checking whether Lissandra has used E Glacial Path, W Ring of Frost, and R Frozen Tomb. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster and use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target someone in the backline. If there’s no safe target to pick off, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

Leblanc.watch: If LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark is on you, her next ability deals increased damage, so stay back and wait for the mark to expire. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, get out of range with Fizz Q Urchin Strike or Fizz E Playful / Trickster before the root takes hold.
Leblanc.build: LeBlanc’s main damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor. Consider a spell shield to interrupt combos that start with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice before stacking more resistance, and get movement speed to leave telegraphed attack areas.
Leblanc.fight: When LeBlanc uses W Distortion to go in, engage after the time to return expires or she uses the return. Early on, save Fizz E Playful / Trickster and poke briefly to chip away at her health and create a chance to finish her off.
Leblanc.laning: Last-hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident to restore mana and make it easier to cast abilities again. If LeBlanc pushes the wave and disappears from vision, alert your team immediately. Before roaming, push the wave toward her turret.
Leblanc.combo: Hit LeBlanc with Fizz R Chum the Waters after LeBlanc W Distortion’s return has expired or been used. As the shark knocks her up, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack, saving Fizz E Playful / Trickster to escape.
Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc uses W Distortion is a chance to close the gap, but if she can return, wait until the return window ends or she uses it. Once LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and LeBlanc R Mimic’s crowd control are down, engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster for her counterattack.
Leblanc.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating isolated targets in the late game, but it is hard to engage when the enemy team is grouped.
Leblanc.teamfight: Approach from the side and, once LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and LeBlanc R Mimic’s crowd control are down, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target one enemy in the backline. Before engaging, save Fizz E Playful / Trickster as an escape. If the enemy team is grouped and it is hard to find a target to pick off, do not engage; use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter their formation.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, her follow-up abilities are likely to hit too, so bait it out and dodge before approaching. It can bind up to two targets even if an ally is in front, so do not stand in a line with an ally. When the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark appears, dodge sideways or avoid it with Fizz E Playful / Trickster.
Lux.build: For your first purchase, prioritize movement speed to help you leave the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance to reduce Lux’s magic damage. Armor does not help against damage from Lux P Illumination, Q Light Binding, or E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.fight: Bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then briefly close in to chip away at her health. Engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to respond to her counterattack. If one of Lux’s abilities hits you, get out of her basic attack range so she cannot detonate the Illumination mark with a basic attack.
Lux.laning: Fizz P Nimble Fighter lets you pass through minions to approach, but do not force an engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike while Lux Q Light Binding is available. Last-hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident, and since Fizz has no innate healing, build up short trades before going for the finish. If you push Lux out of lane, push the wave toward her turret before joining a side lane or the jungle.
Lux.combo: The safest order is to hit Lux with Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up. While she is airborne, land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to escape. After Lux Q Light Binding misses, you can also make a short trade with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility ability, so the moment Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to close the gap. Engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, but save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to avoid Lux’s counterattack and get out. If you need to dodge Lux Q Light Binding with Fizz E Playful / Trickster, do not recast it too early; use the full untargetable duration.
Lux.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating isolated targets in the late game, but it is hard to engage when Lux’s team is grouped.
Lux.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of head-on, and engage after Lux Q Light Binding is down while saving Fizz E Playful / Trickster. Use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target one enemy in the backline, entering from a different direction than your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity does not stop you all at once. If you cannot reach a target to pick off, give up on the engage and use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to a nearby enemy, so do not go for a last hit next to that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void being cast, move outside the line between the rifts and engage after the silence ends. Malzahar R Nether Grasp is dangerous because of its suppression and max-health-based damage, so do not enter an area without vision alone while it is available. You can avoid it before it is cast with Fizz E Playful / Trickster, but a movement ability cannot remove suppression once it has already been applied.
Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance first to counter Malzahar’s main damage. If you need to counter the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp, get Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. Keep in mind that options that only greatly increase health leave you vulnerable to max-health-based damage.
Malzahar.fight: When Malzahar P Void Shift is active, damage and crowd control are less effective, so break it first before fighting. Engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike when Malzahar Q Call of the Void and R Nether Grasp are down, and make a short trade with an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to avoid a counterattack or escape.
Malzahar.laning: Early on, last-hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident and keep your distance from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions. Fizz has no innate healing, so chip away at his health with short trades before going for the finish. If Malzahar pushes the lane, pressure him with your jungler and engage while Malzahar P Void Shift is down.
Malzahar.combo: Break Malzahar P Void Shift first, then hit him with Fizz R Chum the Waters when Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down or you have allied support. As the shark knocks him up, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to escape.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no mobility ability to create distance, so the moment Malzahar Q Call of the Void and R Nether Grasp are down is your chance to engage. When you go in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, you will take attacks during the dash, so check that window first. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to avoid enemy abilities or get out.
Malzahar.phase: Malzahar W Void Swarm stacks up over time and makes the matchup harder, so slow his growth with early pressure and by joining your jungler. Fizz remains strong at assassinating isolated targets in the late game, but it is hard to engage when the enemy team is grouped.
Malzahar.teamfight: Approach from the side instead of going in head-on, and wait for targeted crowd control such as Malzahar R Nether Grasp to be used. Once Malzahar P Void Shift is broken and his Voidlings are gone or have not yet been summoned, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target an enemy in the backline. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster before engaging, and if it is hard to pick off a target, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter their formation.

Mel.watch: If Mel E Solar Snare hits you at the center of the orb, it roots you and can be followed by Mel Q Radiant Volley, so dodge to the side. If you cannot dodge it, use the full untargetable duration of Fizz E Playful / Trickster to avoid it. Do not throw Fizz R Chum the Waters hastily while Mel W Rebuttal is available. If you have been hit by Mel’s attacks multiple times, watch out for an execute even if you still have health, and after the fight, wait somewhere safe until the stacks disappear.
Mel.build: From your first purchase, prioritize magic resistance to counter Mel’s magic damage. Mel P Searing Brilliance, Q Radiant Volley, and E Solar Snare all deal magic damage, so magic resistance is more effective than armor. Movement speed is also useful for leaving telegraphed areas.
Mel.fight: After Mel E Solar Snare is down, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack, using Fizz E Playful / Trickster to avoid her counterattack. Fizz has no innate healing, so build up your poke before going for the finish instead of trying to finish her in one go early on.
Mel.laning: Fizz P Nimble Fighter lets you pass between minions and look for Fizz W Seastone Trident poke. Secure last hits precisely with Fizz W Seastone Trident to sustain your mana and ability rotation. Apply early pressure to limit Mel R Golden Eclipse’s opportunities to scale, and before roaming, push the wave toward Mel’s turret.
Mel.combo: First, bait out Mel W Rebuttal with a basic attack, then hit her with Fizz R Chum the Waters. As the shark knocks Mel up, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge Mel E Solar Snare or escape.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility ability, so the moment Mel E Solar Snare is down is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Fizz Q Urchin Strike then, saving Fizz E Playful / Trickster for her counterattack. If Mel E Solar Snare is still available, it can hit you during Fizz Q Urchin Strike’s dash, so do not rush the engage.
Mel.phase: Mel R Golden Eclipse’s permanent scaling makes the matchup harder over time, so do not force your way into a grouped enemy team in the late game.
Mel.teamfight: Approach from the side and, once Mel E Solar Snare and W Rebuttal are down, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target an enemy in the backline. Before engaging, save Fizz E Playful / Trickster so you can avoid her counterattack. If Mel hides behind her team and is hard to pick off, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter their formation.

Neeko.watch: If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs roots you, it can lead into Neeko R Pop Blossom, so avoid standing on top of an ally. When you see Neeko R Pop Blossom begin, leave its area; if dodging is difficult, use Fizz E Playful’s untargetability to ride it out. If Neeko approaches while disguised, you may not see the windup, so create distance early.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first to deal with Neeko’s main damage. If you keep dying to Neeko R Pop Blossom after being rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs, prioritize tenacity. Consider movement speed to help you leave the warned attack area.
Neeko.fight: Look for a short trade right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, then whittle her down and look for a finish. Before going in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, make sure Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom are unavailable. Keep Fizz E Playful ready for the counterattack.
Neeko.laning: Early on, use Fizz E Playful conservatively because of its mana cost and long cooldown. Last-hit minions with Fizz W Seastone Trident, and step in to harass when Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down. If you push Neeko out of lane, push the wave toward her turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Neeko.combo: Hit Neeko first with Fizz R Chum the Waters, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up. While she is airborne, land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack. Save Fizz E Playful until you need to dodge Neeko’s counterattack or disengage.
Neeko.escape: The window to engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike opens after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom are used. Hitting Neeko with Fizz R Chum the Waters then makes it easier to keep her in reach.
Neeko.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating isolated targets late game, but it is difficult to engage if Neeko is grouped with her team.
Neeko.teamfight: Wait on a flank for Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom to be used, then use Fizz R Chum the Waters on a backline target while keeping Fizz E Playful ready. If an opponent who may be Neeko in disguise approaches your team, spread out early so you are not all hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom. If you cannot reach the target you need to pick off, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

Naafiri.watch: If you are hit once by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and start bleeding, create distance until the bleed ends to avoid a second hit. Naafiri cannot be targeted while Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, so use Fizz R Chum the Waters after it ends. Do not roam alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available, and pull back right after an ally dies so you are not picked off in succession.
Naafiri.build: Survive early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage and Fizz has low armor, so build armor first. If healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate makes it hard to finish her, buy Oblivion Orb and upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to.
Naafiri.laning: Early on, conserve Fizz E Playful / Trickster because of its mana cost and long cooldown. Use Fizz P Nimble Fighter to move through minions, then briefly harass with an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack; use Fizz W Seastone Trident for last hits too. If you push the opponent out of lane, send the wave toward their turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Naafiri.combo: After Naafiri W The Call of the Pack ends, hit Naafiri first with Fizz R Chum the Waters. Close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up, then land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack while she is airborne. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster until you need to dodge the counterattack or disengage.
Naafiri.escape: Do not go in just because either Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or Naafiri E Eviscerate is down. In particular, while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is unavailable and another mobility spell is also down, close the gap with Fizz Q Urchin Strike or Fizz E Playful / Trickster and land Fizz R Chum the Waters. If you engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, you will take attacks during the dash, so only use it after the opponent's spells are down.
Naafiri.phase: During mid-game roams, the risk of being picked off by Naafiri is highest, so maintain wide vision and do not roam alone. Late game, grouping makes Naafiri’s pack vulnerable to area damage and makes it harder for her to reach the backline, while Fizz can target isolated opponents.
Naafiri.teamfight: Group with allies to reduce the chance of being picked off in succession by Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit. From a flank, Fizz should target one backline opponent with Fizz R Chum the Waters, but save Fizz E Playful / Trickster before going in. If the target is hiding behind the allied formation, give up on the engage and use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the formation.

Orianna.watch: Position yourself based on where Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball. Near the ball, Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in, so be ready to ride it out with Fizz E Playful / Trickster. Do not recast E to end the untargetable state early.
Orianna.build: There is no basis in the information for choosing a starting item. If you choose a defensive stat, build magic resistance to deal with Orianna’s basic attacks and spell damage.
Orianna.fight: The chance to trade comes right after Orianna uses Q Command: Attack to move the ball away from herself. She then lacks the bonus armor and magic resistance from Orianna E Command: Protect, so close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack. Avoid fights where you take repeated basic attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.laning: Last-hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident, and conserve Fizz E Playful / Trickster because of its mana cost and cooldown. If you push Orianna out of lane, push the wave toward her turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Orianna.combo: The safest sequence is to hit Orianna first with Fizz R Chum the Waters, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up. Land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack while she is airborne, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster until you need to dodge the counterattack or disengage.
Orianna.escape: Choose to engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike when Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down or the ball is far away and cannot pull you in with her ultimate. Orianna has no spell to create distance herself, so after closing in, Fizz R Chum the Waters can limit her chance to escape. If Orianna R Command: Shockwave is still available, save Fizz E Playful / Trickster for the counterattack.
Orianna.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating isolated targets late game, but it is difficult to engage if Orianna is grouped with her team.
Orianna.teamfight: Check the ball’s position from a flank, and target a backline opponent with Fizz R Chum the Waters when Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down and Fizz E Playful / Trickster is ready. If Orianna is behind her team and difficult to pick off, do not go deep; use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the formation.

Qiyana.watch: If Qiyana approaches with river element, move out of range of the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. If you have a wall at your back, Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can knock you into it and stun you, so fight in an open area; when dodging is difficult, use Fizz E Playful / Trickster’s untargetability to ride it out.
Qiyana.build: Qiyana’s main damage is physical and Fizz has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Survive early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
Qiyana.fight: The chance to counterattack comes right after both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are used. Whittle her down with a short trade, and if Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent are also down, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster for the counterattack.

Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster before engaging so you have a way out. If the target is difficult to pick off, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you and Ryze Q Overload deals more damage, so dodge Ryze E Spell Flux first. If you get marked, keep your distance, and don’t rush in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike while Ryze W Rune Prison is still available.

Ryze.combo: For a safe assassination, hit Ryze with Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks him up. Land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack while he’s airborne, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to disengage.

Ryze.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating a single target late game, but it’s hard to engage when the enemy team is grouped.
Ryze.teamfight: Look for backline targets with Fizz R Chum the Waters from the flank instead of engaging head-on. Go in when Ryze W Rune Prison is down and Fizz E Playful / Trickster is available. If you can’t isolate a target, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

Sylas.watch: If you’re clipped by Sylas Q Chain Lash, immediately move out of the crossing point where it explodes after a delay. Sylas W Kingslayer heals more at low health, so don’t wait too long to finish him.

Close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks him up, then land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster until you need to dodge his counterattack or disengage.

Once you’ve confirmed both mobility abilities have been used, close the distance with Fizz Q Urchin Strike or Fizz E Playful / Trickster and catch him with Fizz R Chum the Waters.

Go in when Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down and Fizz E Playful / Trickster is available. Right after Sylas dives in with E, knock him up with Fizz R to create a chance to kill him before he heals with Sylas W Kingslayer. If your target is hiding behind your team’s formation, use Fizz R to scatter the enemy formation.

Syndra.watch: Syndra E Scatter the Weak can stun you by pushing an orb, so move off the orb’s line when you see Syndra Q Dark Sphere. Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak target the ground, so walk out of the telegraphed area or dodge with Fizz E Playful / Trickster. Move away from areas covered with multiple orbs, where Syndra R Unleashed Power is more dangerous.
Syndra.build: Buy boots early to get enough movement speed to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak on foot. Build magic resist first against Syndra’s main magic damage, and get health to withstand the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.fight: The moment after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down is your chance to engage. Close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack, and use Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge her counterattack or escape. Fizz has no innate healing, so chip away at her health with short trades early before looking for a finish.
Syndra.laning: Secure minion last hits with Fizz W Seastone Trident to refund mana and get your abilities back sooner. Between minions, use Fizz P Nimble Fighter’s unit pass-through to change your approach. If you push Syndra off the lane, send the wave toward her turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Syndra.combo: The safest finish is to hit Syndra with Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks her up. Land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack while she’s airborne, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to disengage. If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is still available, keep in mind that you’ll take its hit during Fizz Q Urchin Strike’s dash.

If there’s a Syndra Q Dark Sphere between you and her, first move off the orb’s line. If you have to engage while Syndra E Scatter the Weak is still available, think carefully before using Fizz E Playful / Trickster to start the fight.
Syndra.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating a single target late game, but it’s hard to engage when the enemy team is grouped. Syndra’s abilities gain additional effects at max rank, so reassess your distance when their effects change.
Syndra.teamfight: Look for Syndra in the backline with Fizz R Chum the Waters from the flank instead of head-on. Engage after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, keeping Fizz E Playful / Trickster available, and avoid areas covered with multiple Syndra Q Dark Sphere orbs. If Syndra is hiding behind your team’s formation and is hard to isolate, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

Talon.watch: Talon W Rake applies passive stacks if you’re hit by both the outward and returning strikes, so move out of the return path if the first strike hits you. Fizz E Playful can dodge the returning strike, but use it carefully early because it costs a lot of mana and has a long cooldown. Don’t chase too far while Talon R Shadow Assault is available, since he can escape with stealth.

If the healing from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is disrupting your assassination, buy Oblivion Orb first and upgrade it to Morellonomicon when you can afford to.
Talon.fight: Dodge the return of Talon W Rake, then trade briefly and chip away at his health before looking for a finish. Right after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy, close the distance with Fizz Q Urchin Strike while his mobility tool is down. Keep Fizz E Playful available as much as possible to dodge his counterattack and escape.
Talon.laning: Use Fizz W Seastone Trident to secure last hits and maintain your mana and ability uptime. Talon may roam, so ward jungle paths and share his position. When you roam yourself, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Talon.combo: If Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down, hit him with Fizz R Chum the Waters first. Close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks him up, then land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack. Save Fizz E Playful to dodge Talon’s counterattack or disengage.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy is your chance to close the distance. Dodge the return of Talon W Rake and go in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike. Don’t chase far if Talon R Shadow Assault is available. When you use Fizz E Playful, stay untargetable until the attack you’re avoiding has finished.
Talon.phase: Talon’s influence falls off late game, but Fizz also has trouble assassinating a single target when the enemy team is grouped.
Talon.teamfight: If Talon dives into your backline, group with your team to respond and look for a chance to knock him up with Fizz R Chum the Waters. When targeting the backline, engage with Fizz R Chum the Waters from the flank after the enemy’s targeted crowd control is down, and keep Fizz E Playful available. If you can’t isolate a target, don’t force the engage; use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in the gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of basic attack range. When you need to dodge the card, use the full untargetable duration of Fizz E Playful / Trickster. Stand behind minions against Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards poke.

Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge his response.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge, so if you are trapped, move around inside and wait for it to disappear. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where and when it will land, so watch the ground marker and dodge to the side. If your health is below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Veigar.laning: Stand behind minions so Veigar Q Baleful Strike cannot hit you and grant him stacks, and use Fizz W Seastone Trident to secure last hits. If you have pushed him back, send the wave toward the enemy turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Veigar.combo: The safest sequence is to hit Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks the target up. Land an empowered basic attack with Fizz W Seastone Trident while they are airborne, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to disengage.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility, so the moment after Veigar E Event Horizon is used is your opportunity to engage. Close the distance with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, but save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to counter his response or disengage. If you are trapped, do not jump straight into the edge; use Fizz Q Urchin Strike or Fizz E Playful / Trickster to get out.
Veigar.phase: In the late game, Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power keeps stacking, putting you at a disadvantage. Before objective fights, check Veigar’s position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon.
Veigar.teamfight: From the flank, target the backline with Fizz R Chum the Waters after Veigar E Event Horizon is used. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster before engaging. If the target you need to pick off is hiding behind your team’s formation, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

If you are hit by Vex R Shadow Surge, move toward your allies, and use the untargetable duration of Fizz E Playful / Trickster when Vex dashes in.

If reaching the backline target is difficult, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the formation. Move low-health allies out of range first to prevent Vex R Shadow Surge from chaining kills.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals him and grants movement speed once empowered, so do not force an engage when your health is low. If Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, keep minions between you or move out of range. If you are infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, retreat until the effect ends.

Use Fizz W Seastone Trident to secure last hits and manage your mana, and keep minions between you when you see Vladimir charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood. After pushing the lane, send the wave toward the enemy turret, then join the jungle or a side lane.
Vladimir.combo: Use light poke to draw out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool, then hit with Fizz R Chum the Waters as the pool ends. Close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks him up and land an empowered basic attack with Fizz W Seastone Trident. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge his response or disengage.
Vladimir.escape: The moment after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your decisive opportunity to engage. If Vladimir has used Vladimir E Tides of Blood, close the distance with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to disengage.

Vladimir.teamfight: If you are infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, retreat until it ends, then engage again, and do not group with allies and get hit together. From the flank, confirm that Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, then target the backline with Fizz R Chum the Waters. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster for after you engage. If reaching the target you need to pick off is difficult, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so avoid standing in line with the minion wave and move to the side. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, stop trading inside it and leave immediately to avoid being stunned. Use Fizz E Playful’s untargetability to dodge Viktor R Arcane Storm when needed.

When using Fizz Q Urchin Strike to engage, you can still be hit during the dash, so check first whether Viktor W Gravity Field is still available. Save Fizz E Playful to counterattack after engaging.

Land empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attacks while he is airborne, and save Fizz E Playful to disengage. Be cautious about using a combo that starts with Fizz E Playful while Viktor W Gravity Field is still available.

If you enter Viktor W Gravity Field, do not keep fighting inside; leave immediately and use Fizz E Playful if needed. When you need to avoid the stun, do not recast Fizz E Playful early; use the full duration of its untargetability.

Engage when Viktor W Gravity Field is down and Fizz E Playful is available, and do not stay within Viktor W Gravity Field’s area. If the target is hiding behind the enemy formation, do not force your way in; use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter their formation.

Xerath.watch: If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, you can take his full follow-up, so do not engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike while it is available. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so move well to the side when you see him charging it, and leave the area targeted by Xerath W Eye of Destruction.

Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attacks. Use Fizz E Playful / Trickster against his counterattack.

Take advantage of Xerath’s high mana costs by farming while avoiding only his heavy damage; when his mana runs low, push the lane and call your jungler. When roaming, push the wave toward Xerath’s turret.
Xerath.combo: For a safe assassination, hit Xerath with Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks him up. Land empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attacks while he is airborne, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to disengage. If you engage first with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, do so only after Xerath E Shocking Orb is down.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so engage right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Close the distance with Fizz Q Urchin Strike then, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster for his counterattack. If you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge immediately or, if you can reach him, engage while Xerath is unable to move.
Xerath.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating a single target in the late game, but it is difficult to engage when the enemy team is grouped.
Xerath.teamfight: From the side, confirm Xerath E Shocking Orb is down, then use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target a backline champion while saving Fizz E Playful / Trickster. If the target is hiding behind the enemy formation and you cannot reach them, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter their formation.

Zed.watch: Zed Q Razor Shuriken and Zed E Shadow Slash deal physical damage, so be careful not to take both in a trade. Watch the shadow’s position and move outside Zed E Shadow Slash’s range to avoid the slow. When Zed R Death Mark comes in, use Fizz E Playful / Trickster’s untargetability to avoid it.
Zed.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Zed’s main damage is physical, so get armor first to survive a full combo. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so do not rely on stacking health alone.
Zed.fight: Look for an opening after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, when the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already switched positions. Dodge Zed Q Razor Shuriken, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attacks, saving Fizz E Playful / Trickster for his counterattack. Early on, chip away at his health with short trades before going for the finish.
Zed.laning: Last-hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident to preserve mana and improve your ability uptime. Fizz E Playful / Trickster has a high mana cost and cooldown early on, so save it for when you need to dodge Zed’s key attacks. If you push Zed out of lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Zed.combo: Hit Zed with Fizz R Chum the Waters first when he cannot escape with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. Close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks him up and land empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attacks. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to avoid Zed’s counterattack or disengage.
Zed.escape: Even right after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, do not rush to chase if Zed R Death Mark is still available. If the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already switched positions, and Zed R Death Mark is not yet available again, you have an opportunity to close the distance with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and Fizz E Playful / Trickster. Avoid the slow from Zed E Shadow Slash by moving outside the shadow’s range.

Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster before engaging; if you cannot get in, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the enemy formation. Move with your allies so Zed has no isolated target to pick off.

You can avoid Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado and Yone R Fate Sealed with Fizz E Playful / Trickster’s untargetability, so do not recast E early when you need to dodge them.

For your item choices, consider movement speed to get out of the range of Yone’s telegraphed attacks, and account for both physical and magic damage if building resistance. Do not engage first with Fizz Q Urchin Strike while Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado or Yone R Fate Sealed is available. If Yone enters his spirit form, look for a chance to stop his return with the knock-up from Fizz R Chum the Waters.

Land empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attacks while he is airborne, and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to disengage. If you engage first with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, check that Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado and Yone R Fate Sealed are down.

Yone can escape with several mobility tools, including Yone E Soul Unbound, so close the distance carefully if only one of them is down.
