Yone.phase: Fizz remains strong at assassinating a single target in the late game, but it is difficult to engage when the enemy team is grouped.
Yone.teamfight: From the side, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to target one backline champion, and engage after Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado and Yone R Fate Sealed are down, saving Fizz E Playful / Trickster. Keep your distance from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave does not hit multiple people, and make sure you are not standing alone at the very back of your formation where Yone R Fate Sealed can reach you. If it is difficult to reach the target you need to pick off, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter the formation.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, sleep triggers shortly afterward, making Zoe Q Paddle Star! easy to land at that moment. Dodge the bubble with Fizz E Playful / Trickster. If it has already hit, move behind a wall or an ally before you fall asleep and stay outside the angle of Zoe Q Paddle Star! Even a missed bubble remains as a trap, so watch narrow paths without vision and bush entrances.
Zoe.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can leave telegraphed attack ranges. Magic resistance helps against Zoe’s damage more than armor, but you need a large health pool against the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. Focus on dodging the bubble before stacking more magic resistance.
Zoe.fight: In the early game, don’t use Fizz E Playful / Trickster carelessly and get stuck in a long trade; chip away at Zoe with short trades. Once Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge her retaliation. You take attacks normally while dashing with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, so don’t rush in while the bubble is still available.
Zoe.laning: Use Fizz P Nimble Fighter to move through minions and approach, and last-hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident to maintain your mana and ability uptime. Fizz has no innate healing, so chip away at her health before looking for a finish. If you’ve pushed Zoe back, push the wave toward her turret, then join a side lane or the jungle.
Zoe.combo: The safest sequence is to land Fizz R Chum the Waters first, then close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike as the shark knocks Zoe up and land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to dodge her retaliation or disengage. If Zoe uses R Portal Jump, aim Fizz R Chum the Waters at the spot she started from, where she must return.
Zoe.escape: Right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, look for a chance to close the gap with Fizz Q Urchin Strike or Fizz E Playful / Trickster. If Zoe uses R Portal Jump, predict where she’ll return and throw Fizz R Chum the Waters there.
Zoe.phase: Even late game, Fizz can pick off Zoe when she’s alone, but it’s hard to engage if she’s grouped with her allies.
Zoe.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; target Zoe in the backline with Fizz R Chum the Waters from the side. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control is down and Fizz E Playful / Trickster is ready. If Zoe is behind her team and hard to reach, use Fizz R Chum the Waters to scatter their formation.

Yasuo.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game to survive. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Yasuo.fight: Strip Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then take a short trade. Look for the moment right after Yasuo throws his tornado and his Q Steel Tempest stacks reset. If Yasuo R Last Breath is also down, engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to respond to his counterattack.
Yasuo.combo: When Yasuo’s tornado and Yasuo R Last Breath are down, land Fizz R Chum the Waters first. As the shark knocks Yasuo up, close in with Fizz Q Urchin Strike and land an empowered Fizz W Seastone Trident attack. Save Fizz E Playful / Trickster to disengage.
Yasuo.escape: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can be recast shortly, so don’t engage just because he used it once. Go in during the window after Yasuo throws his tornado and his Q Steel Tempest stacks reset, with R Last Breath also down. Catch him with Fizz R Chum the Waters and close the gap with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, but save Fizz E Playful / Trickster so you can escape.
Yasuo.phase: Even late game, Fizz is strong at assassinating a single target, but it’s hard to engage when the enemy team is grouped.
Yasuo.teamfight: Target someone in the backline with Fizz R Chum the Waters from the side instead of engaging from the front. Engage when Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s knock-up and R Last Breath are down and Fizz E Playful / Trickster is available. If you can’t reach the target you want to pick off, use R to scatter the enemy formation.
